dependent_variable.name: E_IMPDUM_t
dependent_variable.definition: Indicator equal to 1 when estimated goodwill impairment amount E_GDWLIP is nonzero in year t and 0 otherwise. In the pre-SFAS 142 (1996–2000) sample, E_GDWLIP is the annual reduction in GDWL if it exceeds a 5% threshold relative to beginning goodwill and negative special items (SPI) are at least as large as the reduction.

evidence.quote: E_IMPDUMt (IMPDUMt) is a dummy variable that is equal to one if firms have nonzero E_GDWLIP (GDWLIP) in year t and zero otherwise.

evidence.quote: The first column of Panel A reports the results in the pre-142 period using E_IMPDUM.
The second column reports results for the post-142 period using E_IMPDUM.
The third column compares the coefficients across the pre-142 and post-142 regressions.
The fourth column reports results for the post-142 period using IMPDUM. The results resemble those using E_IMPDUM.

scope.quote: Our primary objective is to examine the impact of SFAS 142 on the timeliness of goodwill impairments.
H1. Goodwill impairment is timelier in the pre-SFAS 142 period.

method.quote: Panel A: Conditional logit regressions (firm-level clustering)

sample.quote: Our primary sample employs common stocks from the intersection of the Compustat fundamental annual database and the CRSP stock return database from 1996 to 2011.
Consequently, the pre-SFAS 142 period in our sample is from 1996 to 2000, and the postSFAS 142 period is from 2004 to 2011.
Since our study focuses on goodwill impairments, we limit our sample to firm-years with a positive goodwill balance on Compustat at the beginning of the year.
We then exclude observations with both a decline in the number of segments and a reduction in the goodwill balance from our sample.
